newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sphinx restructuring to save NLG 30 mln.
newsitem.headline: Sphinx restructuring to save NLG 30 mln.

text.p: Sanitary ware maker Sphinx Gustavsberg said on Wednesday its restructuring programme was expected to boost operating results by some 30 million guilders in the longer term.

"In three years' time operating results will improve by some 30 million guilders as a result of the current restructuring... it is a gradual process," Sphinx Gustavsberg chairman Hans van Vliet told a results news conference.
The company earlier reported a loss from ordinary operations of 15.1 million guilders over the 1996/97 year ended March 31, compared with a year-earlier profit of 9.1 million.
Operating profits declined by some two thirds to 11.9 million guilders from 35.9 million.
Van Vliet said one third of the improvement in operating profits would come from relocating production to low-wage countries.
The firm announced in March it had taken a 66 percent stake in Polish sanitary goods maker ZWS Wroclaw.
Van Vliet said Sphinx Gustavsberg was working its way out of a downturn and therefore it was difficult to make predictions about short-term performance.
But he added the firm expected to cut some 600 jobs during the year, reducing the workforce to 3,000 by end 1997/98.
